propertySets.name: Pset_BuiltSystemRailwayLine
propertySets.definition: Properties common to the definition of a railway line system, which is a set of functional tracks with explicit terminals. It is usually composed of a set of tracks with continuous track parts and alignments.

properties.name: LineID
properties.definition: The unique identifier of the line.

properties.name: IsElectrified
properties.definition: Indicates whether the track system is electrified or not.

properties.name: LineCharacteristic
properties.definition: Indicates the characteristic of the line.
